title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'text-rendering' for Crisp Web Typography
tweet: Refine your web text clarity! Discover how CSS 'text-rendering' impacts character display & anti-aliasing for superior #UIDesign & #UserExperience. A must for #CSSTypography pros! #WebFonts
tip: Master 'text-rendering' to control how browsers render your web fonts. For dense body text, 'optimizeLegibility' can activate advanced typographic features like ligatures and kerning, significantly improving readability, but watch for potential performance impacts on older browsers or very large text blocks. For crisp headings or performance-sensitive areas, consider 'optimizeSpeed' or 'geometricPrecision' to prioritize speed or sharp outlines. Combine with '-webkit-font-smoothing' and '-moz-osx-font-smoothing' for a polished cross-browser look, especially on macOS.
css_snippet: body { text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; } h1 { text-rendering: geometricPrecision; }
